#include <string>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    string s;
    cin >> s;

    vector<string> runs;
    string currentRun;

    for (size_t i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
        if (i > 0 && s[i] != s[i - 1]) {
            runs.push_back(currentRun);
            currentRun.clear();
        }
        currentRun += s[i];
    }
    if (!currentRun.empty()) {
        runs.push_back(currentRun);
    }

    int result = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < runs.size(); i++) {
        string run = runs[i];
        int length = run.length();
        if (i == 0 && run[0] == '.') {
            if (length % 2 == 1) {
                result++;
            }
        } else if (length % 2 == 0) {
            result++;
        }
    }
    cout << result << endl;

    return 0;
}
